Victorian Public Transport Patronage

Source: R/data.R
patronage.Rd

Monthly average daily public transport patronage in Victoria, Australia, categorised by transport mode, day of the week, day type and reporting month.

Usage

patronage

Format

A data frame with 4,450 rows and 7 variables:

VariableTypeDescription
yearIntegerReporting year, from 2018 to 2026.
monthIntegerReporting month, from 1 (January) to 12 (December).
dateDateFirst day of the reporting month, used to identify the month.
day_of_weekOrdered factorDay of the week, ordered from Monday to Sunday.
day_typeCharacterDay classification: Normal Weekday, School Holiday Weekday or Weekend.
modeCharacterPublic transport mode: Metropolitan bus, Metropolitan train, Regional bus, Regional train or Tram.
avg_daily_patronageNumericReported average daily public transport patronage for the corresponding month, mode, day and day type.

Source

Victorian Government open transport data, Monthly Average Patronage by Day Type and By Mode.

Dataset: https://opendata.transport.vic.gov.au/dataset/monthly-average-patronage-by-day-type-and-by-mode

Data resource: https://opendata.transport.vic.gov.au/dataset/monthly-average-patronage-by-day-type-and-by-mode/resource/c2f1279b-c414-4371-a12e-e1cc5836ee1a

Details

Each observation represents a reporting combination of month, day of the week, day type and transport mode.

The dataset covers January 2018 to March 2026. The final reporting year is therefore incomplete.

The dataset contains reported average daily patronage values, not monthly patronage totals. Values should not be summed across reporting categories to estimate monthly totals.

Examples

# Load the bundled dataset
data("patronage", package = "victransport")

# View the first observations
head(patronage)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 7
#>    year month date       day_of_week day_type          mode  avg_daily_patronage
#>   <int> <int> <date>     <ord>       <chr>             <chr>               <dbl>
#> 1  2018     1 2018-01-01 Monday      Normal Weekday    Metr…              308450
#> 2  2018     1 2018-01-01 Tuesday     Normal Weekday    Metr…              359800
#> 3  2018     1 2018-01-01 Wednesday   Normal Weekday    Metr…              400250
#> 4  2018     1 2018-01-01 Monday      School Holiday W… Metr…              298500
#> 5  2018     1 2018-01-01 Tuesday     School Holiday W… Metr…              295500
#> 6  2018     1 2018-01-01 Wednesday   School Holiday W… Metr…              299950

# Examine available transport modes
unique(patronage$mode)
#> [1] "Metropolitan bus"   "Metropolitan train" "Regional bus"      
#> [4] "Regional train"     "Tram"              

# Check the reporting period
range(patronage$date)
#> [1] "2018-01-01" "2026-03-01"
